0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 1-5 on the road, 13th in the East and on a two-game losing streak) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (4-7, 3-3 at home, 12th in the West and on a three-game losing streak). Brooklyn is without Egor Demin, who is out with a leg bruise, and Nolan Traore is day-to-day with calf soreness and a game-time decision, while New Orleans is missing Trendon Watford (ankle) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), with Trey Murphy III day-to-day with knee tendinitis and also a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 116-113 New Orleans win on January 14 in New Orleans.
